cohort: Pregnant women attending antenatal care in Nigeria.
finding: Excessive prenatal care utilization was associated with employment, age 20-39 years, pre-eclampsia, previous cesarean birth, cesarean delivery, and preterm birth.
mod_finding: Women with excessive prenatal care utilization were significantly more likely to have a cesarean birth (30.2% vs 28.2%, p=0.008) compared with adequate utilizers.
